items.title: 3 Reasons to Sell EXPD and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Expeditors’s 32.6% return over the past six months has outpaced the S&P 500 by 14.2%, and its stock price has climbed to $188.25 per share. This was partly thanks to its solid quarterly results, and the performance may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

items.title: American Airlines Expands U.S.-Asia Reach With STARLUX Codeshare Deal
items.summary: AAL expands U.S.-Asia connectivity through a STARLUX codeshare, adding single-ticket access to 20 major U.S. destinations and Taipei links.

items.title: Wabtec Secures $700M+ Rail Services Deal, Expands Africa Footprint
items.summary: WAB lands a $700M-plus CTG services deal, lifting its Simandou-related business above $1.2B and expanding recurring rail revenue in Africa.

items.title: Is UPS Stock Cheap Because It Chose To Shrink?
items.summary: United Parcel Service (UPS) generates free cash flow worth 6.8% of its market capitalization of about $80.6 billion, well above the 4.4% median for an S&P 500 company. A yield that high means a bargain, or a business the market expects to shrink. UPS is shrinking on purpose. It has cut about 2 million pieces a day of lower-quality Amazon volume, and investors want to see what the smaller network earns.

items.title: Alaska Airlines Strengthens Hawai'i Network With 737 Expansion
items.summary: ALK adds daily 737-800 service on select Honolulu-Kahului flights, boosting inter-island capacity and premium amenities in Hawaii.

items.title: Delta Air Lines Boosts LAX Presence With Biggest-Ever Schedule
items.summary: DAL plans its largest-ever LAX summer schedule in 2027, with 200+ daily departures and expanded premium lounges and onboard offerings.

items.title: Is Expeditors Stock Outperforming the S&P 500?
items.summary: While Expeditors has outperformed relative to the S&P 500 Index over the past year, analysts are cautious about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Expeditors International Of Washington (EXPD) Stock Could Be 12% Overvalued On Cash Flow
items.summary: Expeditors International of Washington has seen its stock climb sharply in recent years, which puts fresh attention on what investors are paying for its underlying cash flows. With the share price around recent highs, the key issue is whether that market value lines up with what the business is expected to generate in future cash.
